component.name: Proton Drive
component.summary: Sync and manage your Proton Drive - app and CLI, unofficial packaging of the official client

description.p: Unofficial AppImage packaging of the official Proton Drive CLI published by Proton AG, plus an open-source desktop app built on top of it. The CLI binary inside is the unmodified upstream linux build, verified against the SHA-512 checksum published on proton.me before it is packaged.

Double-clicking the AppImage opens the app window: sign in once, pick a folder, and it stays in sync both ways in the background - deletions, renames and moves included, with a tray icon and optional start-at-login. Running the AppImage with arguments uses the upstream command-line client unchanged (auth, filesystem operations, sharing, albums and photos, Google Takeout import); --help lists everything.
The app needs Python 3 with PyQt6 from your distribution's official repositories (python3-pyqt6 on Debian/Ubuntu, python3-qt6 on Fedora, python-pyqt6 on Arch).
